name: Abaddon
desc: Places Scarab Hives that periodically spawn scarabs to seek out and attack nearby enemies and beds.
adv: Each hive spawns scarabs that hunt down enemies and beds. Scarabs attack every 0.5 seconds. Scarabs from the same hive do not stack their damage, so two scarabs from one hive deal the same DPS as one. Scarabs from different hives do stack, so two hives can hit you twice as hard, and three hives deal up to 3x the DPS. Hives are weak to pickaxes and break in 5 hits with a wooden pickaxe, 4 with stone, and 2 with iron or diamond. When a hive expires or is broken, its scarabs take about 10 damage. Scarab upgrades and Hive upgrades are bought separately.

items.name: Scarab Upgrade 1
items.desc: Scarabs deal 4 damage and have 200 HP. Scarabs can now fly and climb blocks to reach enemies.

items.name: Hive Upgrade 1
items.desc: Hive lasts 15 seconds and spawns 4 scarabs in total.

items.name: Scarab Upgrade 2
items.desc: Scarabs deal 6 damage, have 200 HP, and move faster. An exploding scarab with 100 HP spawns alongside the 4th scarab, with the same damage and block destruction as TNT.

items.name: Hive Upgrade 2
items.desc: Hive lasts 18 seconds and spawns a scarab every 3.5 seconds, 6 in total. An exploding scarab spawns with the 4th one, making 7 in total.

items.name: Scarab Upgrade 3
items.desc: Scarabs deal 8 damage and have 225 HP. Every time a scarab hits an enemy, you heal 1 HP.

items.name: Hive Upgrade 3
items.desc: Hive still lasts 18 seconds. Each spawn has a 25% chance to spawn an extra scarab. An exploding scarab still spawns with the 4th one.

abilities.name: Place Hive
abilities.desc: Places a Scarab Hive that spawns scarabs. Base (Tier 0): scarabs have 150 HP and deal 2 damage. The hive lasts 12 seconds and spawns a scarab every 4.5 seconds, 3 in total. You get a new hive every 20 seconds, holding up to 2.

passives.name: Hive Supply
passives.desc: You receive a new Scarab Hive every 20 seconds and can hold up to 2 at a time.

passives.name: Scarab Climbing
passives.desc: Scarabs can fly and climb blocks to reach enemies.

passives.name: Scarab Lifesteal
passives.desc: Every time a scarab hits an enemy, you heal 1 HP.

strategy.title: Protect your hives
strategy.text: Enemies can break hives quickly, so place them up high or hide them where they are hard to reach.

strategy.title: Let scarabs tank for you
strategy.text: Use your scarabs as a shield: they soak up hits while you fight.

balWhy: The hives are easily broken and a bit expensive, but it provides good value if you know how to play it.

counter.title: Fireballs and hive breaking
counter.text: Use fireballs, or break the hive before it spawns any more bugs.

name: Adetunde
desc: Start with a powerful Frosty Hammer. Hitting enemies has a chance to drop Frost Crystals, which you can spend to upgrade your hammer.
adv:
You spawn with a Frosty Hammer, which has a 4.5 block reach, the same as a sword. Every hit on an enemy has an 80% chance to give you a Frost Crystal. Crystals are spent on hammer upgrades, can be stored in your Personal Chest, and are all lost when you die.
Tier 1 costs 3 crystals (9 in total), Tier 2 costs 7 crystals (21 in total), and Tier 3 costs 15. The upgrades are Speed, Shield and Damage, and you can only pick one Tier 3 upgrade. Every time you upgrade, you are frozen in place for 2 seconds.
Shield is capped at 50. If you have not hit anyone for 2 seconds, it drops by 5 every 0.75 seconds.
The Tier 3 upgrade you pick gives you something special: Damage unlocks the Arctic Slam ability, Shield unlocks the Permafrost Shield ability, and Speed (cooldown) unlocks the Blizzard Storm passive.

items.name: Frosty Hammer
items.desc: Your main weapon, with a 4.5 block reach, the same as a sword. Tier 0 deals 23 damage every 0.35 seconds. Each hit has an 80% chance to drop a Frost Crystal.

items.name: Frost Crystal
items.desc: Gained from hitting enemies (80% chance). Spend them on hammer upgrades or store them in your Personal Chest. You lose all of them when you die.

abilities.name: Open Hammer Upgrades
abilities.desc:
Opens the hammer upgrade menu. Each upgrade freezes you in place for 2 seconds.
Tier 0: 23 damage every 0.35 seconds.
Tier 1 (3 crystals): 30 damage every 0.32 seconds, and 2 shield per attack.
Tier 2 (7 crystals): 40 damage every 0.28 seconds, and 3 shield per attack.
Tier 3 (15 crystals, pick one): 52 damage, or 4 shield per attack, or a 0.25 second cooldown. Each one unlocks its own ability or passive.

abilities.name: Permafrost Shield
abilities.desc: Gain 30 shield for 6 seconds. The shield then explodes in a 7 block radius, dealing damage based on how much shield you have. The explosion has 100% armor penetration.

abilities.name: Arctic Slam
abilities.desc: Hits 3 times over 2 seconds for 40, then 30, then 20 damage (90 in total). Each hit has 10% armor penetration. Reaches a 20 block radius, 9 blocks wide from end to end and 3 blocks tall. Damages and breaks blocks depending on their type, and launches enemies 2 blocks into the air.

passives.name: Frost Crystal Drops
passives.desc: 80% chance to gain a Frost Crystal. Crystals are lost on death, but you can keep them safe in your Personal Chest.

passives.name: Upgrade Freeze
passives.desc: You are frozen in place for 2 seconds every time you upgrade your hammer.

passives.name: Shield Decay
passives.desc: Shield is capped at 50 and drops by 5 every 0.75 seconds.

passives.name: Blizzard Storm
passives.desc: After landing 4 hits in a row, an aura with a 6 block radius forms around you. It ticks every 0.525 seconds, starting at 3 damage and rising by 1 per tick up to a max of 8. The longer you keep hitting, the longer the aura lasts after you stop: every hit adds 1 extra tick.

strategy.title: Hit and run early
strategy.text: Your hammer has a slow cooldown at first, so use hit-and-run tactics to collect crystals safely. Save them up before upgrading your cooldown, then your damage.

strategy.title: Upgrade order
strategy.text: Always keep upgrading, and take Cooldown and Damage before Shield.

strategy.title: Best Tier 3 pick
strategy.text: Tier 3 Damage gives the best DPS. You can choose the others if you prefer them or want to play that specific style.

strategy.title: Arctic Slam on bridges
strategy.text: Use Arctic Slam when enemies are crossing bridges. It destroys the bridge and drops them into the void.

balWhy: You save a ton of resources that would normally go into your sword just by upgrading the hammer, and how hard it is to upgrade is part of the cost.

counter.title: Limit its hits
counter.text: Don't let it get many hits on you.

counter.title: Don't let it escape
counter.text: If it is close to its final upgrade, don't let it get away, or it will chest all of its crystals.

name: Aery
desc: Killing enemies adds to your collection of spirit butterflies. Each spirit butterfly amplifies sword and projectile damage. Aery's base health is reduced by 10%.
adv:
Aery spawns with 90 HP. You gain 2 butterflies for every kill, and none for assists. Each butterfly is one stack, and stacks increase your projectile damage by 80% of the butterfly's value.
The bonus slows down as you collect more: each new stack adds less damage than the last, and eventually each butterfly adds less than 1 damage. After killing an enemy, you have to wait 25 seconds before you can gain stacks from that same enemy again.
When you die you lose around 30% of your stacks, a little more or less depending on how many you have.

calc.title: Stack calculator
calc.label: Butterfly stacks
calc.note: Bonus damage from butterfly stacks. The listed values are exact; other numbers use the formula damage = 2.0104 × stacks^0.7144.

passives.name: Butterfly Stacks
passives.desc: Gain 2 butterflies for every kill. Assists give none. Each butterfly is one stack.

passives.name: Butterfly Damage
passives.desc: Increases your projectile damage by 80% of the butterfly's value. Each extra stack adds less than the last, eventually under 1 damage per butterfly.

passives.name: Same-Enemy Cooldown
passives.desc: You cannot gain stacks from the same enemy again for 25 seconds.

passives.name: Stack Loss
passives.desc: You lose around 30% of your stacks, a little more or less depending on how many you have.

strategy.title: Get support early
strategy.text: Aery needs help early in the game to build up stacks. Around 20 stacks is the sweet spot.

strategy.title: Don't ego fights
strategy.text: Losing stacks hurts, so avoid fights you don't need to take.

strategy.title: Go ranged at 20 stacks
strategy.text: Once you reach 20 stacks, switch to ranged weapons so you don't risk losing all your stacks late in the game.

balWhy: Many people use it, and even though it may be slightly outclassed, it still has a use because it works great with support.

counter.title: Be prepared
counter.text: Don't fight it if you are unprepared, and warn your teammates.

name: Agni
desc: Throw cluster bombs at your enemies and watch them go flying! Blast off with your Rocket Boost ability.
adv:
Agni's kit is built around fire and explosives. Fire deals 3 damage per tick for 3 ticks, 9 damage in total.
Rocket Boost launches you into the air and burns enemies it hits. Cluster Bombs are thrown at enemies and burst into smaller fire bombs that spread out and explode. Throwing a Cluster Bomb takes 2 seconds from start to finish.

items.name: Cluster Bomb
items.desc: You get a new Cluster Bomb every 35 seconds, holding up to 5, or you can buy one in the shop. The bomb deals 16-17 damage and applies Fire. It then drops 8 smaller fire bombs in a 25 block radius. Each one explodes in a 3x3 area, dealing 9 damage and applying Fire. Throwing it takes 2 seconds in total.

abilities.name: Rocket Boost
abilities.desc: Launches you up to 7 blocks into the air. Deals 12 damage to enemies and applies Fire (3 damage per tick, 3 ticks).

strategy.title: Save your iron
strategy.text: Don't waste early-game iron on Cluster Bombs. Only buy them when you have plenty of iron left over.

strategy.title: When to throw them
strategy.text: Use Cluster Bombs in group fights, and always use one when you have to fight someone one-on-one.

strategy.title: Rocket Boost tricks
strategy.text: Use Rocket Boost to save yourself from fall damage, or to deal extra damage to your enemy.

balWhy: It just doesn't do a lot of damage compared to similar kits that spawn an item every few seconds, and the Rocket Boost jump is pretty situational.

counter.title: Bait the jump
counter.text: Try to bait it into using Rocket Boost near you so it misses.

name: Alchemist
desc: Use flasks to brew various potions with foraged ingredients.
adv:
Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers spawn frequently around the map. You can pick up all of them, and drop them or store them in a chest. The same goes for the potions you make, but not the flasks.
You can buy Alchemist Flasks in the shop for 10 iron, with a max of 16. While holding a flask, add Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers to brew a special potion:
3 Mushrooms: Sleep Splash Potion
3 Flowers: Heal Splash Potion
1 Thorn + 2 Mushrooms: Poison Splash Potion
2 Thorns + 1 Flower: Big Shield

items.name: Alchemist Flask
items.desc: Buy up to 16 in the shop. While holding it, add Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers to brew special potions. Flasks cannot be stored in a chest.

items.name: Mushroom
items.desc: Spawns frequently around the map. Used for Sleep and Poison potions. Can be picked up, dropped and stored in a chest.

items.name: Thorn
items.desc: Spawns frequently around the map. Used for Poison potions and Big Shields. Can be picked up, dropped and stored in a chest.

items.name: Flower
items.desc: Spawns frequently around the map. Used for Heal potions and Big Shields. Can be picked up, dropped and stored in a chest.

items.name: Sleep Splash Potion
items.desc: Stuns anyone hit, including you, for 2 seconds in a 3x3 block radius.

items.name: Heal Splash Potion
items.desc: Heals 30 HP in a 5x5 block radius.

items.name: Poison Splash Potion
items.desc: Deals 6 damage per tick for 10 ticks, with 80% armor penetration. Poison cannot kill: it leaves enemies on 1 HP at minimum.

items.name: Big Shield
items.desc: Gives you 30 shield.

abilities.name: Add Thorns
abilities.desc: Adds a Thorn to the flask. Used in the Poison Splash Potion (1 Thorn) and Big Shield (2 Thorns) recipes.

abilities.name: Add Mushroom
abilities.desc: Adds a Mushroom to the flask. Used in the Sleep Splash Potion (3 Mushrooms) and Poison Splash Potion (2 Mushrooms) recipes.

abilities.name: Add Flowers
abilities.desc: Adds a Flower to the flask. Used in the Heal Splash Potion (3 Flowers) and Big Shield (1 Flower) recipes.

passives.name: Foraging
passives.desc: Thorns, Mushrooms and Flowers spawn frequently around the map. You can pick up, drop and store them in a chest.

strategy.title: Craft for your playstyle
strategy.text: Choose which potions to craft depending on how you play.

strategy.title: Solo and offensive play
strategy.text: Mainly craft Heal and Sleep potions, so you can stunlock enemies and keep yourself healthy.

strategy.title: Supporting your team
strategy.text: Craft Big Shields and Heal potions for your teammates, and Sleep and Poison potions for yourself to help in fights.

strategy.title: Always be prepared
strategy.text: Use a Shield potion before every fight, and have a Poison potion ready to throw. Prioritize keeping 1 Poison potion and 1 Shield potion on hand, and always keep crafting Heal potions and Shields.

balWhy: Even though not many people use it, stunlocking people is not healthy game design. It might need a nerf in that area, with buffs elsewhere to balance it out.

counter.title: Keep building
counter.text: It can stunlock you very easily, so keep building to mess up its aim.

counter.title: Waste its healing
counter.text: Use ranged weapons to make it waste all of its healing.

name: Arachne
desc: The Spider Queen uses web bridges to traverse the map and can summon spiderlings from her webs to attack enemies. Enemies are slowed if they run into her webs.
adv:
Arachne shoots webs that slow enemies down and double as a bridge only you and your Arachne teammates can use. Enemies who touch cobwebs are slowed by a lot, and the more cobwebs they touch, the slower they get.
You can summon spiders while you have webs placed. You get 1 to 4 spiders depending on how many cobwebs are up, so 1 cobweb gives 1 spider and 4 or more cobwebs give 4. Spiders disappear after 6 seconds. Each spider spawns with 30 HP and deals 4 damage every 0.5 seconds. When a spider kills or assists on an enemy, its damage and HP go up, to a max of 80 HP and 15 damage.

abilities.name: Aim Web Bridge
abilities.desc: Shoots a web in any direction with a 17 block line radius. Enemies who touch the cobwebs are slowed by a lot, and the slow builds up the more cobwebs they touch. You can jump onto the cobwebs and use them as a bridge, but only you and other Arachne teammates can use it.

abilities.name: Spider Summon
abilities.desc: Summons 1 to 4 spiders from your webs, depending on how many cobwebs are up (1 cobweb = 1 spider, 4 or more = 4). Spiders last 6 seconds before they disappear. Each spider spawns with 30 HP and deals 4 damage every 0.5 seconds. A spider that kills or assists on an enemy gains damage and HP, up to 80 HP and 15 damage.

passives.name: Sticky Webs
passives.desc: Enemies are slowed by a lot, and the slow gets stronger the more cobwebs they touch.

passives.name: Spider Growth
passives.when: When a spider kills or assists
passives.desc: The spider's damage and HP increase, up to a max of 80 HP and 15 damage. Spiders spawn with 30 HP and 4 damage.

strategy.title: Move fast and save iron
strategy.text: Use Arachne for movement, and save a ton of iron you would normally spend on blocks.

strategy.title: Grab loot first
strategy.text: On most maps you can use the ability right away and get to the middle for loot before anyone else, depending on the mode.

strategy.title: Slow your enemies
strategy.text: The webs slow enemies down a lot, which gives you a big advantage in PvP.

strategy.title: Let spiders tank
strategy.text: Use your spiders to soak up damage while you fight.

balWhy: Nobody really notices or cares about the spiders leveling up, so that should be removed. Its damage should be improved overall, and it could get some armor penetration as a unique perk.
notes: The webs make people get anti-cheated the second they touch them.

counter.title: Don't touch the webs
counter.text: Touching the webs makes you anti-cheat so badly that it's pretty much an automatic death.

name: Archer
desc: Can headshot with bows, crossbows and headhunters, which normally can't! Deal 12.5% more projectile damage and gain access to the Tactical Crossbow in the Item Shop.
adv: Normal bows and crossbows can't headshot, but Archer can headshot with the Bow, Crossbow and Headhunter. Archer also deals extra damage with each of them. The Tactical Crossbow and Tactical Headhunter are cheaper for Archer, at 6 emeralds and 21 emeralds. Each weapon's damage, cooldown and bonus over normal damage are listed under Abilities and items.

items.name: Bow
items.desc:
Damage depends on how long you charge it.
Lowest charge: 10 damage (15 headshot), 0.625 second cooldown.
Highest charge: 20 damage (30 headshot), 1 second cooldown.
Bodyshots deal 12.50% more damage than normal, and headshots deal 79.89% more.

items.name: Tactical Crossbow
items.desc:
Cheaper for Archer. Deals 42.75 damage (64 headshot) with a 1.25 second cooldown.
Bodyshots deal 25.74% more damage than normal, and headshots deal 88.59% more.

items.name: Tactical Headhunter
items.desc:
Cheaper for Archer. Deals 67.5 damage (101.25 headshot) with a 1.25 second cooldown.
Bodyshots and headshots both deal 22.73% more damage than normal.

passives.name: Headshots
passives.desc: Archer can headshot with the Bow, Crossbow and Headhunter. Normal bows and crossbows can't headshot.

passives.name: Projectile Bonus
passives.desc: Deals extra damage with the Bow, Crossbow and Headhunter compared to normal. The bonus for each weapon is listed under its item.

passives.name: Cheaper Weapons
passives.desc: The Tactical Crossbow costs 6 emeralds and the Tactical Headhunter costs 21 emeralds.

strategy.title: Aim for headshots
strategy.text: Headshots are the best part of Archer, so always aim for the head.

strategy.title: Save emeralds for the Crossbow
strategy.text: Save the emeralds you get from the middle and buy the Tactical Crossbow as fast as you can. Archer gets the biggest damage increase over a normal crossbow, so it gives you a lot of control.

balWhy: Its damage is worse than every special bow kit, including kits that aren't even in the Ranged class. It needs a unique mechanic instead of more damage, since the headshot gimmick is a bit outdated.

counter.title: Not much counterplay
counter.text: There isn't much counterplay, since no kit has better ranged damage.

counter.title: Deny the middle
counter.text: Don't let it collect the middle emeralds, so it can't get its crossbow early.

name: Ares
desc: A powerful ancient warrior that uses electric-charged throwing spears to destroy his enemies.
adv:
Ares throws electric-charged Spears. You can buy Spears in the shop for 40 iron, holding up to 10, or wait 40 seconds for a free one to generate. Free spears won't generate if you already have 3 or more.
Spears fly slowly, at half the speed of an arrow, but have a massive range. They can hit through walls, and can hit someone above or below a floor or ceiling. They can also hit you, so be careful.
When a Spear hits, it applies Zapped 1 for 5 seconds in a 4x4 block radius, which reduces healing and shields by 40%.

items.name: Spear
items.desc: Buy up to 10 in the shop, or wait 40 seconds for one to generate (it won't generate if you have 3 or more). Deals 40 damage with 40% armor penetration, with a 0.75 second throw cooldown. It has a massive range, but travels at half the speed of an arrow. It can hit through walls and floors or ceilings, and it can hit you. Applies Zapped 1 for 5 seconds in a 4x4 block radius, reducing healing and shields by 40%. Killing someone with it gives you another Spear.

passives.name: Spear Generation
passives.desc: You get a free Spear every 40 seconds. It won't generate if you already have 3 or more Spears.

passives.name: Spear Refund
passives.when: When you kill someone with a Spear
passives.desc: You gain another Spear.

passives.name: Zapped 1
passives.desc: Everyone in a 4x4 block radius, including you, is Zapped for 5 seconds. Healing and shields are reduced by 40%.

strategy.title: Back off and throw
strategy.text: Damage someone first. When they are in range of a Spear, back off and throw it to get another one back.

strategy.title: Spam late game
strategy.text: Once you have a lot of iron later in the game, spam Spears.

strategy.title: Don't hit yourself
strategy.text: The blast can hit you too, so make sure you are outside the 4x4 radius when you throw.

strategy.title: Target healers and shielders
strategy.text: Zapped cuts healing and shields by 40%, so aim at enemies who heal or shield for the best results.

balWhy: It now gets outclassed by other kits, and it needs more armor penetration to make up for all the damage it lost through nerfs.

counter.title: Dodge early spears
counter.text: Early game it won't have many spears, so dodge them by placing blocks and building over them. This baits it into throwing and missing.

counter.title: Fight up close
counter.text: Fight it up close so the spear also hits Ares himself.

name: Axolotl Amy
desc: Use your pet axolotls to empower yourself and nearby teammates with shields, increased attack damage, faster break speed and health regen.
adv:
Buy Axolotls in the shop to power up yourself and nearby teammates. Every Axolotl has a 5 second cooldown and a 9 block radius.
Shield Axolotl gives shield when you are damaged, Damage Axolotl boosts damage after you hit someone, Break Speed Axolotl speeds up block breaking, and Health Regen Axolotl heals you when you drop below 50% HP.

items.name: Shield Axolotl
items.desc: Gives you and nearby teammates 15 shield when they get damaged. 9 block radius.

items.name: Damage Axolotl
items.desc: Gives you and nearby teammates 16% more damage. Activates after you deal damage. 9 block radius.

items.name: Break Speed Axolotl
items.desc: Gives you and nearby teammates 60% break speed. 9 block radius.

items.name: Health Regen Axolotl
items.desc: Heals you and your teammates by 1% HP for 12 ticks, with 0.45 seconds between ticks. Activates when you take damage below 50% HP. 9 block radius.

strategy.title: Shield Axolotl early
strategy.text: Get the Shield Axolotl early in the game and stick with your teammates so they benefit from it too.

strategy.title: Damage Axolotl later
strategy.text: Only buy the Damage Axolotl after you have iron armor and a stone sword.

strategy.title: Break Speed is the strongest
strategy.text: Break Speed Axolotl is the most powerful one. Use it to shred through bed defenses.

strategy.title: Health Regen is expensive
strategy.text: The Health Regen Axolotl costs too much. Only buy it once you have the essentials you need, like a crossbow, diamond armor, enchants and pearls.

balWhy: Some of the prices are outrageous for what the Axolotls do. The prices, and what each Axolotl does, might need some changes.

counter.title: Strong bed defense
counter.text: There isn't much counterplay besides your bed defense. It can shred obsidian, so place 2 layers plus wool, since it one-shots stone.

name: Baker
desc: Gain access to health-gain apples, speed-boost pies, and spawn with a knockback baguette!
adv:
Baker always spawns with the Knockback Baguette and can store it in chests for teammates to pick up. Baker can also drop all of its items for teammates, and they have the same capacities.
Apples, Golden Apples and Speed Pies are bought in the shop. Eating an apple slows you down while you eat.
A Golden Apple heals 175 HP in total: 30 instantly, then 5 HP every 0.5 seconds for 15 seconds (145 HP), along with 5% damage reduction until it runs out.

items.name: Health Apple
items.desc: Max 3. Heals 20 HP. Takes 0.75 seconds to eat, and you move slower while eating.

items.name: Speed Pie
items.desc: Unlimited capacity. Gives 100 seconds of speed that increases your movement by 100% (2x).

items.name: Golden Apple
items.desc: Max 3. Takes 1 second to eat, and you move slower while eating. Heals 30 HP instantly, then 5 HP every 0.5 seconds for 15 seconds (145 HP), plus 5% damage reduction until it runs out. 175 HP in total.

items.name: Knockback Baguette
items.desc: Baker always spawns with it. Deals 1 damage and 4 blocks of knockback. Can be stored in chests for teammates to pick up.

balWhy:
For 3 emeralds you are basically unkillable, unless the other team has enchants and gets lucky and rolls static. Coils aren't much of a counter because they aren't mobile. Healing more than double your HP for 3 emeralds is insane, and with the Speed Pie, which outclasses most movement kits, it's a bit crazy.
Suggested changes: keep the healing the same but tick every 0.75s instead of 0.5s, which makes it easier to deal with in fights. Raise the damage reduction by another 5% to make up for it, and nerf the Speed Pie to 1.75x movement instead of 2x.

passives.name: Knockback Baguette
passives.desc: Baker always spawns with the Knockback Baguette and can store it in chests for teammates to pick up.

passives.name: Team Supplies
passives.desc: Baker can drop all of its items for teammates, and they have the same capacities.

strategy.title: Loot early
strategy.text: Focus on loot early in the game. If you have the emeralds, buy a Speed Pie to get diamonds quicker.

strategy.title: Dominate at tier 3
strategy.text: Once you reach tier 3, you can dominate with all the OP items.

strategy.title: Pair it with Berserker
strategy.text: Combine Baker with Berserker to simply be unkillable, even when static'd.

counter.title: Coil your base
counter.text: Place coils in your base so Baker gets heavily nerfed when it arrives.

name: Barbarian
desc: Build rage by damaging enemies. Instead of buying swords, your sword is upgraded when you reach enough rage. You lose all your rage on death. The Emerald Sword is replaced by the Rageblade.
adv:
Barbarian cannot buy swords. You start with a wooden sword and upgrade it by building rage, which you get from dealing damage and from kills. Once upgraded, your sword never goes back to the previous one when you die.
Damage needed for each upgrade:
Stone sword: 85
Iron sword: 210
Diamond sword: 430
Rageblade: 650
Your rage resets each time you upgrade, so you need 1375 damage in total.
Ranged damage gives 2x less rage than other damage. Killing an enemy gives you around 40 damage worth of rage. You cannot get rage from enemies who respawned within the last 9 seconds.
When you die you lose all your rage and restart the tier you are on.

items.name: Rageblade
items.desc: Replaces the Emerald Sword. Deals 70 damage with a 0.25 second cooldown.

balWhy: It is really good in casuals but terrible in ranked. A fix could be giving its normal swords more attack speed, so it isn't just "no kit". That wouldn't change much for casuals, but in ranked it would become a unique kit that attacks faster after each hit, up to a cap. The Rageblade wouldn't change, only the other swords.

passives.name: No Sword Shop
passives.desc: Barbarian cannot buy swords. You start with a wooden sword and upgrade it by building rage.

passives.name: Rage
passives.when: When you deal damage or kill
passives.desc: Damage and kills build rage. Ranged damage gives 2x less rage, and a kill gives around 40 damage worth of rage. You get no rage from enemies who respawned within 9 seconds.

passives.name: Sword Upgrades
passives.desc: Reaching each rage amount upgrades your sword: stone, iron, diamond, then Rageblade. Rage resets on every upgrade, and you need 1375 damage in total.

passives.name: Death Penalty
passives.desc: You lose all your rage and restart the tier you are on, but your sword never goes back to the previous one.

strategy.title: Early game
strategy.text: Get armor unless you are getting rushed. Make sure you don't die to the first enemy rush, or you will be at a disadvantage for the rest of the match.

strategy.title: Midgame
strategy.text: Look for tanky enemies with lots of HP to farm rage off of.

strategy.title: After the Rageblade
strategy.text: Play safe and don't risk dying, because the chances of getting a Rageblade again are low.

counter.title: Early game Barbarian
counter.text: Don't give it the damage it needs for a stone sword.

counter.title: Late game Barbarian
counter.text: If it has a diamond sword, focus it and make sure it is constantly reset, because getting a Rageblade that early is not good for the whole lobby.

name: Beekeeper Beatrix
desc: Catch bees around the map to upgrade your Bee Hive. Upgrading your Bee Hive will return additional iron and emeralds.
adv:
Bees spawn around the map, similar to Alchemist's ingredients but not as many, and the amount depends on the map. A bee on the ground disappears 3 minutes after it spawns, and bees pulse every 7 seconds so they are easier to find. Hold the Bee Net to pick a bee up: it goes into your inventory as a separate item, then you put it in a Beehive. You lose your bees when you die, but you keep the net. Bees inside a hive never despawn.
You can place up to 5 Beehives. A hive with 0 bees only produces iron, 1 iron every 10 seconds. The more bees inside, the faster it drops loot, and from 3 bees it can drop diamonds, and from 4 bees it can drop emeralds. Each drop is only 1 resource at a time: either 1 iron, 1 diamond or 1 emerald. After 10 bees a hive doesn't drop any faster. There are no hive upgrades.
Hives have normal block HP and are weak to pickaxes: they break in 5 hits with a wooden pickaxe, 4 with stone, and 2 with iron or diamond. They can also be broken by TNT and fireballs if they aren't covered with ceramic or obsidian.

items.name: Bee
items.desc: Spawns around the map, similar to Alchemist's ingredients but not as many, and the amount depends on the map. Pulses every 7 seconds so it's easier to find. Disappears 3 minutes after spawning on the ground, but never inside a hive. Pick it up with the Bee Net, put it in a Beehive, and you lose it if you die.

items.name: Beehive
items.desc: You can place up to 5. Produces loot based on how many bees are inside (see the drop table). It has normal block HP and no upgrades. Weak to pickaxes: breaks in 5 hits with a wooden pickaxe, 4 with stone, and 2 with iron or diamond. TNT and fireballs can break it unless it is covered with ceramic or obsidian.

items.name: Bee Net
items.desc: Hold it to pick up bees. Bees go into your inventory as a separate item. You keep the net when you die, but you lose your bees.

tables.title: Hive drop table
head: Bees in hive
Drops every
Iron
Diamond
Emerald
tables.note: Each drop is 1 iron, 1 diamond or 1 emerald. Chances were measured from tests with 5 hives over 2 minutes 30 seconds, so they are estimates. Emeralds jump from about 4% to about 12% at 8 bees. A hive doesn't drop any faster after 10 bees, so a new hive is more beneficial.

balWhy: It gives a lot of loot, but it's risky to use because the hive can be found and broken if you or your teammates aren't there to protect it.

strategy.title: Don't go past 10 bees
strategy.text: Don't put more than 10 bees in a hive. Making a new hive is more beneficial.

strategy.title: Escape and slow chasers
strategy.text: Buy a ton of blocks so you can escape from people, and buy Gloop (35 iron) to slow down anyone chasing you. It slows them for 1 second and gives them Grounded for 10 seconds, so they can't use movement abilities or ender pearls.

strategy.title: Protect your hive
strategy.text: Surround your hive in ceramic early in the game, then replace it with obsidian so enemies can't place a Siege TNT on it.

counter.title: Break the hive early
counter.text: If you see a Beekeeper collecting bees in the lobby, go for the hive while they aren't there. Do it early, before they have the emeralds to surround it with obsidian.

counter.title: Keep resetting them
counter.text: Keep killing the Beekeeper so they can't get any more bees in their hives.

name: Bekzat
desc: Summon a mythical falcon to dominate an area. Work in tandem to critically strike your companion's target with your feather light bows
adv:
Bekzat's bows are Featherlight, so there is no slowdown while charging a shot. Shots deal normal bow damage, unless the Falcon is targeting the player you are shooting, then you deal increased damage.
The Falcon flies around the enemy it is targeting and attacks every 5 seconds. Its damage and HP go up as you buy better Featherlight bows (see the Falcon tiers table). With the Summon Falcon ability you can target any enemy within 60 blocks by aiming and clicking on them, and once it is out you can recall it with Recall Falcon.
If a player damages the Falcon, it won't heal unless you recall it, and then it heals 6% HP every second. If a player kills the Falcon, you have to wait 5 seconds before it starts recharging, and only once it is at half charge can you summon it again.

items.name: Featherlight Headhunter
items.desc: No slowdown while charging. Upgrades the Falcon to tier 3: 20 damage and 250 HP.

items.name: Featherlight Crossbow
items.desc: No slowdown while charging. Upgrades the Falcon to tier 2: 18 damage and 200 HP.

items.name: Featherlight Bow
items.desc: No slowdown while charging. Upgrades the Falcon to tier 1: 16 damage and 150 HP.

abilities.name: Summon Falcon
abilities.desc: Aim and click on any enemy within 60 blocks to send the Falcon after them. It flies around the enemy and attacks every 5 seconds. If it is killed, it starts recharging after 5 seconds, and you can only summon it again once it is at half charge.

abilities.name: Recall Falcon
abilities.desc: Calls the Falcon back to you. While recalled it heals 6% HP every second. A Falcon that was damaged won't heal unless you recall it.

tables.title: Falcon tiers
head: Tier
Unlocked by
Damage
HP
tables.note: The Falcon attacks every 5 seconds. While it is targeting an enemy, you get +60% critical strike damage against that enemy.

passives.name: Featherlight
passives.desc: There is no slowdown while charging a shot.

passives.name: Falcon Focus
passives.when: Shooting the enemy your Falcon is targeting
passives.desc: You get +60% critical strike damage against them.

strategy.title: Only send the Falcon when you have a target
strategy.text: Make sure to only have the Falcon out when you are targeting someone, otherwise it will be killed easily.

strategy.title: Use the bow
strategy.text: Most kits aren't worth buying a bow for, but Bekzat doesn't need to charge it, so he gets the highest amount of damage out of it.

counter.title: Shoot the Falcon
counter.text: Always target the Falcon when you have a projectile weapon. If you kill it, Bekzat can't use it to target anyone, so he loses the +60% crit damage and becomes very weak for that time.

counter.title: The Falcon is easy to kill
counter.text: Killing the Falcon isn't that hard, so Bekzat is good but not uncounterable.

balWhy: It costs a bit more to use, but the Falcon gives great stalling chip damage and he has really high projectile damage. The Falcon isn't that hard to kill, which keeps him good but not uncounterable.

name: Bounty Hunter
desc: Get assigned bounties for killing certain players in the match. Completing a bounty rewards a random amount of resources.
adv:
A random player in the server is your target. Hunting Time marks your target on the map, but your target also sees your mark, so they know where you are and that they are your target. They can't see the mark if you don't click Hunting Time. You can reroll your target (random) every 60 seconds.
Killing your bounty rewards iron and emeralds, but no diamonds, and the reward scales with how long the game has been going. If you hit your bounty and your teammate kills them, you get the reward too (there is a 5 to 10 second leeway).
After you get a new bounty you have to wait 30 seconds before you can get another one, and that timer starts when you reroll. So if you reroll and kill your target quickly, you still wait out the 30 seconds. If you reroll and don't kill them within 30 seconds, then kill them after that, your next bounty appears right away and the 30 second timer starts again.
You level up by killing your bounty, and each level upgrades Hunting Time (see the level table).

abilities.name: Hunting Time
abilities.desc: Lasts 15 seconds. Marks your target on the map, but your target sees your mark too, so they know you are hunting them. Gives bonuses depending on your level: level 1 +5% damage to your target, level 2 +10%, level 3 the same damage plus +75% movement speed, level 4 the same as level 3 plus 10% less damage taken from and dealt to everyone who isn't your target while active.

abilities.name: Reroll
abilities.desc: Changes your target to a different random player. The 30 second wait before your next bounty starts when you reroll.

strategy.title: Don't use Hunting Time early
strategy.text: Don't activate Hunting Time early in the game. It does no damage, so it only tells your opponent that they are your target.

strategy.title: Use it from level 3
strategy.text: Use Hunting Time once you reach level 3 for the good speed boost. You can use it to run away from fights, not only to catch up to your target.

strategy.title: Get a crossbow fast
strategy.text: Save up for a crossbow as soon as you can. It helps you get to your targets really quickly.

counter.title: Reset before you get hit
counter.text: If you know you are the target and haven't been hit, try resetting before the Bounty Hunter hits you so you don't feed.

balWhy: It's really good in modes with fewer people, and a bit worse in modes with more people.

name: Builder
desc: Fortify blocks with extra health and blast protection using the Builder's hammer. Purchase the Hammer from the Item Shop.
adv:
Builder spawns with a Builder Hammer and 8 Stone Bricks. The Stone Bricks are normal, so you still need to upgrade them. With the hammer you can upgrade blocks using iron or emeralds. Upgraded (reinforced) blocks are blast resistant and have 60% more durability, which makes them harder to break.
It takes about 8 TNT to break a single reinforced stone brick, while the other reinforced blocks still get one shot by TNT. Siege TNT still one shots, but it destroys fewer blocks when they are reinforced than when they aren't.
The hammer can also upgrade other kits' items, like Beekeeper Beatrix's Beehives.
The Bridge Printer is bought in the shop. Use the hammer and click the printer source to turn it on or off, and it stretches out blocks (see the Bridge Printer details).
Fun fact: the official kit description says to buy the Hammer from the Item Shop, but that is out of date. Builder used to need to buy it, and now spawns with it.

items.name: Hammer
items.desc: Builder spawns with it. Upgrades blocks with iron or emeralds, making them blast resistant and giving them 60% more durability. Can also upgrade other kits' items, like Beekeeper Beatrix's Beehives. Click a Bridge Printer source with it to turn the printer on or off.

items.name: Bridge Printer Block
items.desc: Stretches out up to 25 blocks, vertically or horizontally, and you can place up to 24. The source breaks in 2 hits with a wood or stone pickaxe and 1 hit with iron or diamond. The stretched blocks break in 1 hit with a wood pickaxe or better. You don't get it back when it breaks unless its extra blocks haven't been broken. Connected printers activate together with one click, and standing above or below several printers suffocates you.

tables.title: Block upgrade costs
head: Block
Upgrade cost

tables.note: You don't get the Bridge Printer back if you break it, unless its extra blocks haven't been broken or destroyed. You can break certain blocks to make it a certain length before you activate it. It only turns on or off when you are holding your hammer and click the printer source. If several printers are touching, they connect and all activate with one click, no matter which one you press. If you are standing above or below several printers, you will be suffocated.

balWhy: Siege TNT completely obliterates Builder, so it could be changed to destroy fewer blocks when placed on reinforced ones. It's also a bit expensive: obsidian shouldn't cost 1 emerald to upgrade, and 100 iron would be a better price.

counter.title: Place a Siege TNT
counter.text: Just place a Siege TNT and the entire bed will be exposed, unless there is obsidian under it.

strategy.title: Defend your bed early
strategy.text: Place your Stone Bricks around your bed as an early game defense, then upgrade them.

strategy.title: Use Bridge Printers as traps
strategy.text: Use Bridge Printers as traps, or to troll your teammates or enemies by suffocating them or voiding them.

name: Caitlyn
desc: Fulfill assassination contracts to empower your attacks with a deadly decay.
adv:
Caitlyn's attacks apply decay, which deals 2 damage per second for 2 seconds. Hitting an enemy that is already decaying makes the decay 25% stronger per hit, up to double the base damage at 4 total hits. Contracts upgrade the decay so it hits harder, lasts longer, and gets special effects.
Press R to open the contracts menu. It shows the stats of her Dark Decay (duration, damage and bonus effects) and three random players with their team color, armor type and distance in blocks. Pick one to assassinate and upgrade your ability. The target is highlighted in red, so you can see where they are, until they are killed (teammates can help) or you reject the contract, which you can do once every minute.
Better armor on the target gives better upgrades. Sometimes a special contract appears on a player with diamond armor or higher, and completing it gives your decay a special effect. The upgrade and its amount are shown on the contract screen. Amounts are random and scale with the target's armor and how long the game has gone on.

abilities.name: Open Contracts
abilities.desc: Press R to open the contracts menu. Choose one of 3 random players to assassinate and upgrade your decay. Reject the current contract once every minute.

passives.name: Dark Decay
passives.desc: Applies decay: 2 damage per second for 2 seconds. Each extra hit on a decaying enemy adds 25% strength, up to double damage at 4 hits.

strategy.title: Upgrade duration and damage
strategy.text: Focus on the decay duration and decay damage upgrades, or just choose the player nearest to you if they are close.

strategy.title: Get the Fire enchant
strategy.text: Always get the Fire enchant to deal a ton of tick damage.

strategy.title: Early crossbow
strategy.text: Focus on getting a crossbow early to make your life easier.

counter.title: Don't feed a diamond Caitlyn
counter.text: Try not to die to a Caitlyn with diamond armor, as you might give her a special contract.

counter.title: Block after the first hit
counter.text: Caitlyn relies heavily on hitting multiple shots, so if you get hit once, build a wall to stop getting hit again.

balWhy: It's only good in Ranked 5v5s, and even there it has fallen off a bit. In every other mode it's very weak, and it's very late game prone, which most games don't reach. It needs a rework.

name: Cobalt
desc: Every time you take damage you have a chance of dropping a battery on the ground. Once the battery activates you can pick it up for a small shield. After collecting 3 batteries you will overload, gaining movement speed and damage!

name: Cogsworth
desc: Deploy robots that search for generators and collect resources!

name: Conqueror
desc: Place banners to empower nearby allies.

name: Crocowolf
desc: Being in the vicinity of damage dealt builds bloodlust. Activate Beast Form to temporarily give you enhanced damage, knockback, and movement speed. Dealing damage to non-player entities builds more bloodlust. When your bed breaks you will be given full bloodlust.

name: Crypt
desc: Claim souls to build your undead army! Could be unlocked for FREE by completing Crypt's Trials during the Halloween 2022 event.

abilities.name: Recall Skeletons
abilities.note: Only while holding the Necromancer Staff

abilities.name: Set Target
abilities.note: Only while holding the Necromancer Staff

abilities.name: Swap Skeleton Mode
abilities.note: Only while holding the Necromancer Staff
abilities.desc: Switch between Ranged and Fighter Skeletons.

name: Cyber
desc: Deploy and control drones to pickup resources from around the map. Drones can also airdrop primed TNT.

name: Death Adder
desc: Charge up explosive comets to rain destruction on your enemy's base. Collect alchemy crystals to unlock even stronger abilities!

name: Dino Tamer Dom
desc: Can purchase a Dino mount. Charge into defenses to knock them down!

name: Drill
desc: Purchase Drills to deploy on Diamond and Emerald generators. Drills automatically harvest 2x gen resources. Control them to fight off attackers.

name: Eldertree
desc: Collect tree orbs around the map to increase size and max HP. Cannot buy armor.

name: Eldric
desc: Drain health from enemies or sacrifice your health to heal allies. Could be unlocked for FREE by completing Crypt's Coven during the Halloween 2023 event.

name: Elektra
desc: Dash through players to deal electric damage! Hold up to two stacks of dashes and regain all stacks if you kill an enemy with your dash.

name: Ember
desc: Charge the Blade of Fire to ignite in a deadly spin! Striking enemies OR killing Lumen will upgrade your ability to a much more powerful spin.

name: Evelynn
desc: Damage enemies to attract nearby spirits. Consume spirits to instantly teleport and gain an attack buff for a short duration.

name: Farmer Cletus
desc: Invest your resources into crops that yield more diamonds and emeralds.

name: Fisherman
desc: Why fight when you can fish? Catch resources and Fish Coins, upgrade your rod, and use bait to reel in rarer rewards.

name: Flora
desc: Use explosive beehives to deal high damage to your enemies or throw them at yourself for a massive launch.

name: Fortuna
desc: Summon cards to attack players! Deal damage to enhance your cards with different effects.

name: Freiya
desc: Dealing damage will apply stacks of Frost. At four stacks, Frost is consumed and applies Frostbite to the target, making them fragile. Emerald Sword is replaced by the Ice Sword, which applies two stacks per hit. Use your Frost Explosion ability to immediately deal damage to nearby targets with stacks of Frost.

name: Frosty
desc: Passively create Frosted Snowballs for free. Frosted Snowballs are faster and larger.

name: Gingerbread Man
desc: Place gumdrops bounce pads for extreme movement. Using a gumdrop bounce pad negates all fall damage and grants a shield.

name: Gompy
desc: Gompy the Ghost Hunter! Find ghosts around the map, vacuum them and fire them across the map.

name: Gregory
desc: Place gargoyle statues and take control of them.

name: Grim Reaper
desc: Consuming enemy souls grants health regen, movespeed and invulnerability for 2.5s. Combat is disabled while consuming.

name: Grove
desc: Purchase seeds and grow them into flowers that buff allies and enhance generator production. Keep your flowers alive by providing them with spirit energy gathered around the map to prevent them from withering.

name: Hannah
desc: Activate your Execute ability to defeat a nearby enemy with low health! Hannah's base health is reduced by 10%.

name: Hephaestus
desc: Upgrade your Talos Mech to increase shield and damage! Activate Self-Destruct to deal massive damage.

abilities.name: Summon Talos Mech
abilities.note: Only when out of the mech

name: Ignis
desc: Use a spirit bridge to travel around the map healing your allies and providing them with armor buffs.

name: Infernal Shielder
desc: Spawn with a massive shield. Gain energy while holding your shield, and raise your shield to deflect incoming projectiles.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.note: Only while holding the Infernal Shield

name: Isabel
desc: Upgrade her shield by purchasing better swords. Each upgraded shield will block more damage before breaking. The final upgrade, the Emerald Shield, will block all damage from the first hit. Shields reactivate after 30 [sic] seconds.

name: Jack
desc: Lob bundles of poisonous pumpkin oil across the map.

name: Jade
desc: Launch into the air with a giant war hammer. Higher launches deal more slam damage, and the hammer can be upgraded throughout the match.

name: Kaida
desc: Summon a powerful dragon's claw to swipe multiple enemies at once, or summon a dragon head through a rune below you to damage all surrounding enemies. Upgrade your claw and summon attack by damaging enemies with your summon spell.

name: Kaliyah
desc: A fearsome warrior with a fiery punch!

name: Krystal
desc: Keep moving (especially on frozen blocks!) to increase your momentum and movement speed. At high momentum, trigger jumps to dodge.

name: Lani
desc: An ascended healer, Lani can purchase the Scepter of Light. Use this Scepter to fly to your low health allies, providing healing and damage reduction!

name: Lassy
desc: Wrangle enemies towards you using a lasso.

name: Lian
desc: A mysterious warrior gifted by the dragon. Control swords to fight your enemy

name: Lucía
desc: Use the candy you get from damaging players to fill up your piñata. When you're ready, smash it for lots of loot!

name: Lumen
desc: Charge the Sword of Light to shoot powerful waves at enemies! Hitting light waves OR killing Ember will upgrade your ability to shoot many powerful beams at once.

name: Lyla
desc: Your bow is replaced with the Floral Bow! Shooting an enemy twice will bloom a flower on their head, attracting a swarm of bees!

name: Marcel
desc: Use your Defense Scanner to instantly purchase blocks in the Defense Schematic shown around your team's bed. Can place two Tesla Traps.

name: Marina
desc: Deploy jellyfish and electrify them with your Electric Pulse ability, causing them to zap nearby enemies. Connect jellyfish to increase the range and power of your ability.

name: Marrow
desc: Defy death and hop around as a skull after taking mortal damage. Survive long enough in this form and you will revive! Use your ability to create poison clouds that damage and slow enemies (this ability also triggers while in skull form).

name: Martin
desc: Absorb life essence from nearby enemies and convert it to max hp! Attack is slower but passively reflects damage for melee hits to the enemy.

name: Melody
desc: Use a guitar and the power of music to heal nearby teammates. Heal yourself for 50% [sic] of the heal given.

name: Merchant Marco
desc: Get resources back on certain item shop purchases! This refund is randomized each game!

name: Metal Detector
desc: Use a Metal Detector to find treasure around the map.

name: Milo
desc: Disguise as a block and pickpocket from other players!

name: Miner
desc: Killing enemies turns them into stone. The Miner can break down the stone for valuables[sic]'’ resources (scaled by the price of enemy's armor + sword). Unable to purchase Axes.

name: Nahla
desc: Use water veil to temporally boost the health regen of nearby allies. Purchase upgrades for your oasis vessel to strengthen your healing and buffing abilities!

name: Nazar
desc: Give up out-of-combat health regeneration to manipulate your life force and empower your attacks or heal. Gain life force by landing shots with life arrows and attacking.

name: Noelle
desc: Tame slimes to befriend your team, providing your teammates with unique buffs that strengthen over time!

name: Nyoka
desc: Charge your Mending Canopy to shine healing light on your allies.

name: Nyx
desc: Trigger the darkness of Midnight to deal ramping increased damage and armor pen.

name: Pirate Davey
desc: Use a TNT Cannon to bombard your enemies.

name: Pyro
desc: Use your flamethrower to spray fire, making enemies brittle, and taking more damage from attacks. Killing brittle enemies rewards ember, which you can use to upgrade your flamethrower.

name: Ragnar
desc: Use your Berserker Rage ability to increase break speed, reduce incoming damage and prevent incoming knockback to rush in on an enemy's bed defense.

name: Ramil
desc: Create sandstorms to control the battlefield, move enemies, and protect allies.

name: Raven
desc: Buy ravens and fly at enemies to deliver deadly doses of poison.

name: Santa
desc: Play as Santa and call in high-explosive sleigh strafe runs!

name: Sheep Herder
desc: Find and tame wild sheep around the map. Each tamed sheep amplifies your damage.

name: Sheila
desc: Start the game with an egg on your shoulder. Get kills to hatch and evolve your Seahorse, increasing its damage and unlocking passive abilities.

name: Sigrid
desc: Summon your mount, charge at your enemies and send them flying! Cannot use weapons while riding the Elk.

name: Silas
desc: The leader of the citizens' rebellion, who encourages and buffs his allies with healing and damage auras!

name: Skoll
desc: Summon your void wolf companion Fenrir to mark an enemy. Deal extra damage to your marked target, gain a speed boost when following their trail, and see them through walls. You can detonate the mark to end the effect and deal damage.

abilities.name: Hunt's End
abilities.note: Only while Fenrir is on a target

name: Smoke
desc: A stealth-focused kit that uses smoke charges to grant invisibility.

name: Sophia
desc: Use a Frost Staff to slow and freeze enemies!

name: Spirit Catcher
desc: Carry a jar of regenerating spirits. Catch wisps from damaged enemies to recharge faster, and recall unused spirits. Place idle spirits together to fuse them into a larger spirit with a chain of shrinking explosions.

abilities.name: Recall Spirits
abilities.note: Only when a spirit is placed

name: Star Collector Stella
desc: Pick up floating stars around the map. Consume them while near teammates to share permanent Max Health and Critical Strike chance!

name: Styx
desc: Connect your Confluence Portal to a slain enemy to teleport you and your allies to that location.

name: Taliyah
desc: Buy eggs & hatch them into chickens! Chickens can either be sold back to the merchant or deployed in combat!

name: Terra
desc: Stomp the ground to gather protective blocks, then kick them at your enemies. Each successful hit permanently increases kick damage!

name: Trapper
desc: Place Snap Traps to stun unexpecting enemies, Damaging a recently trapped enemy will consume a mark dealing extra damage.

name: Trinity
desc: Ascend into an angelic form and switch freely between Light and Void. When you melee attack, Light form grants shield for you and allies, and Void form inflicts max health decay on your target.

name: Triton
desc: An agile warrior with a Trident! Hurl your trident towards a wall, or your opponents, to quickly travel and dominate the battlefield.

name: Trixie
desc: Warp around and confuse your enemies with evasive combat. Every time you use Rift Warp you gain a buff that allows you to reduce Rift Warp's cooldown with melee attacks. You can also use Rift Rewind to teleport back to your last warp point.

name: Uma
desc: Summon creatures from the spirit world to assist you in combat, healing, and resource collecting!

name: Umbra
desc: Toss a hat onto other players to gain the ability to teleport to them from anywhere on the map. Ally players near the target destination are given boosted movement speed and several seconds of invulnerability while enemy players are knocked back and briefly slowed.

name: Umeko
desc: Use chakrams to fight at mid-range. You can turn invisible and escape from battle if you get attacked by a melee attack.

name: Vanessa
desc: Super charge your bow to perform a triple shot.

name: Void Knight
desc: Feed your Void Corruption with resources and kills to upgrade your gear and unlock your abilities of Void Decay and Shielding. With enough resources, unlock the full power of the Void and become the Ascended Void Knight. Void Knight's base health is reduced by 10%.

name: Void Regent
desc: Use a Void Axe to dash forward while slashing at enemies, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

name: Vulcan
desc: Use a high tech tablet to control camera turrets across the map. While holding the tablet, mark enemies or link to your turrets' view.

name: Warden
desc: Imprison the souls of recently killed enemies to increase their respawn time. For each actively imprisoned soul you gain Break Speed and Shield Regeneration.

name: Warrior
desc: Gain grit in battle and can keep fighting after taken fatal damage.

name: Whim
desc: Master arcane secrets to unlock elemental powers! Spawn with a magic spellbook. Deal 20% reduced damage with swords and take 10% increased damage from all sources.

name: Whisper
desc: Control a Spirit Owl to support ally players. Unlocked at Player Level 10.

abilities.name: Heal + Speed
abilities.note: Only while using the owl on another player

abilities.name: Deactivate
abilities.note: Only while using the owl on another player

abilities.name: Fly
abilities.note: Only while using the owl on another player

name: Wren
desc: Summon a secret black market offering powerful potions and random deals. Earn a cut from every sale, and use shadow coins gathered from fallen players to upgrade your shop.

name: Xu'rot
desc: Transform into Dragon Form, unlocking a decaying dragon breath and the ability to fly. Items can't be used while in dragon form and damage scales with the highest tier sword obtained.

name: Yamini
desc: Climb and pounce with feline dexterity! Fall damage is reduced since you always land on your feet.

name: Yeti
desc: Let out a Glacier Roar to temporarily freeze nearby blocks. Frozen blocks can be destroyed extremely fast.

name: Yuzi
desc: Swords are replaced by traditional Dao Swords. Hold attack to execute a forward dash AOE attack.

name: Zarrah
desc: Wields a Cutlass and Blunderbuss. Ability fires the Blunderbuss, damaging and marking enemies ahead while knocking you back. Melee hits on marked foes reset cooldown, cause bleeding, and grant a speed boost.

name: Zenith
desc: Deploy a satellite to disrupt enemy team economies. Enemy shop prices are increased and you get a cut of each purchase!

name: Zeno
desc: Use a magical staff to cast lightning spells.

abilities.name: Ability Swap
abilities.desc: Switch between Normal Lightning and Lightning Storm.

name: Zephyr
desc: Killing enemies gives you a stack of wind, decaying a short while after. Each stack of wind gives you more speed and adds a second wind strike to your attack. At 5 stacks you can triple jump!

name: Zola
desc: Connect enemies with soul links! Damage dealt to linked enemies incurs bonus damage to any other linked enemies. Allies can also be linked, allowing you to take damage in their place.
